title: Establish Project Documentation & Data Format Specification
description: Create root .gitignore, comprehensive README.md, System Requirements Specification, Project Plan, and Data Format Specification for SIH26232.

title: Offline-First Telemetry Engine with Monotonic Sequence Counters
description: Ensure telemetry records preserve monotonic sequence numbers and can be queued offline and batch-synced upon cellular reconnection.

title: Cryptographic Hash Chaining and Tamper Audit Verification
description: Implement canonical serialization, recursive SHA-256 chaining, and instant audit verification for bit-level database tampering.

title: Decentralized Ledger Merkle Tree Rollup & Anchoring
description: Batch telemetry hashes into binary Merkle trees and anchor the root to smart contracts on Polygon zkEVM / AgriChain testnet.

title: Truck-Centric Multi-Compartment Visualization & Live Environmental Telemetry
description: Provide a real-time web dashboard displaying temperature, humidity, ethylene gas, solar harvesting, and compartment overlays.

title: Consumer Provenance QR Code Generation & Transparency Portal
description: Generate verifiable QR codes linking to farm-to-fork origin certificates with GI-tag details and cold-chain compliance scores.

title: Device Identity & ECDSA Asymmetric Signature Ingestion
description: Implement ECDSA secp256k1 keypair signing on edge payloads, backend public-key validation, and rejection of forged or modified telemetry.

title: Supabase RLS Lockdown & Authenticated Ingestion Gateway
description: Lock down Supabase direct anon table insertions, route telemetry through authenticated FastAPI gateway with replay detection and token validation.

title: Persistent Edge Queue & Telemetry Lifecycle State Machine
description: Enforce telemetry record states (received -> verified -> anchored), track sequence gaps in dedicated table, and maintain offline buffer resiliency.

title: Binary Merkle Inclusion Proof Generation & Verification Engine
description: Compute canonical leaf hashes, construct Merkle audit paths (proof arrays), and implement independent record verification endpoint.

title: Live Polygon PoS Amoy Smart Contract Deployment & Anchoring
description: Develop AgriChainAnchor.sol, deploy to Polygon PoS Amoy testnet, submit real on-chain Merkle root transactions, and link PolygonScan proofs.

title: Dashboard Stale-Data Indicator & Reconnection Resilience
description: Add WebSocket exponential backoff reconnection, live network latency benchmark, and clear UI indicator for stale/offline telemetry.
